$comment: Parity contract for the connector manifest route matcher and expectation evaluator. sprites-api (Sprites.Gateway.OAuthProvider.path_allowed?/3, Sprites.Gateway.Connector.Expect and the manifest decoding of expectations) and this repository's scripts/lib/{routes,expect}.mjs must both run every case in this file and agree with it; a change to the semantics is made in sprites-api first and then mirrored here with its vector. The cases come from sprites-api's test/sprites/gateway/oauth_provider_routes_test.exs and test/sprites/gateway/connector/expect_test.exs. routes[]: allowed_paths as in a manifest, optional path_param (PCRE source anchored with \A and \z), method (upper-case, any case accepted, null for any method), path, and whether the gateway forwards it. expectations[]: a probe expect list, a decoded JSON body, and whether every expectation holds. malformed_expectations[]: expect lists the manifest loader must reject. Bodies avoid integral floats such as 1.0: Elixir decodes them as floats and JSON.parse cannot tell them from integers, so `integer` is the one check whose answer depends on the decoder.
